en.text: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌進了耶利哥，正經過的時候，

en.text: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

zhSimplified.text: 有一个人名叫撒该，作税吏长，是个财主。

zhTraditional.text: 有一個人名叫撒該，作稅吏長，是個財主。

en.text: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

zhSimplified.text: 他要看看耶稣是怎样的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看见，

zhTraditional.text: 他要看看耶穌是怎樣的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看見，

en.text: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

zhSimplified.text: 就跑到前头，爬上桑树，要看耶稣，因为耶稣必从那里经过。

zhTraditional.text: 就跑到前頭，爬上桑樹，要看耶穌，因為耶穌必從那裏經過。

en.text: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣到了那里，抬头一看，对他说：「撒该，快下来！今天我必住在你家里。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌到了那裏，抬頭一看，對他說：「撒該，快下來！今天我必住在你家裏。」

en.text: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

zhSimplified.text: 他就急忙下来，欢欢喜喜地接待耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 他就急忙下來，歡歡喜喜地接待耶穌。

en.text: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

zhSimplified.text: 众人看见，都私下议论说：「他竟到罪人家里去住宿。」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人看見，都私下議論說：「他竟到罪人家裏去住宿。」

en.text: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

zhSimplified.text: 撒该站着对主说：「主啊，我把所有的一半给穷人；我若讹诈了谁，就还他四倍。」

zhTraditional.text: 撒該站着對主說：「主啊，我把所有的一半給窮人；我若訛詐了誰，就還他四倍。」

en.text: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「今天救恩到了这家，因为他也是亚伯拉罕的子孙。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「今天救恩到了這家，因為他也是亞伯拉罕的子孫。

en.text: Forthe Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

zhSimplified.text: 人子来，为要寻找、拯救失丧的人。」 （太25·14—30）

zhTraditional.text: 人子來，為要尋找、拯救失喪的人。」 （太25‧14－30）

en.text: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

zhSimplified.text: 众人正在听见这些话的时候，耶稣因为将近耶路撒冷，又因他们以为 神的国快要显出来，就另设一个比喻，说：

zhTraditional.text: 眾人正在聽見這些話的時候，耶穌因為將近耶路撒冷，又因他們以為上帝的國快要顯出來，就另設一個比喻，說：

en.text: He said therefore, “Acertain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

zhSimplified.text: 「有一个贵胄往远方去，要得国回来，

zhTraditional.text: 「有一個貴冑往遠方去，要得國回來，

en.text: Hecalled ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, andtold them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

footnotes.text: 19:13 10 minas was more than 3 years’ wages for an agricultural laborer.

zhSimplified.text: 便叫了他的十个仆人来，交给他们十锭银子，说：『你们去做生意，直等我回来。』

footnotes.text: - 19:13 锭：原文作弥拿，一弥拿约银十两

zhTraditional.text: 便叫了他的十個僕人來，交給他們十錠銀子，說：『你們去做生意，直等我回來。』

footnotes.text: - 19:13 錠：原文作彌拿，一彌拿約銀十兩

en.text: Buthis citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’ t want this man to reign over us.’

zhSimplified.text: 他本国的人却恨他，打发使者随后去，说：『我们不愿意这个人作我们的王。』

zhTraditional.text: 他本國的人卻恨他，打發使者隨後去，說：『我們不願意這個人作我們的王。』

en.text: “Whenhe had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

zhSimplified.text: 他既得国回来，就吩咐叫那领银子的仆人来，要知道他们做生意赚了多少。

zhTraditional.text: 他既得國回來，就吩咐叫那領銀子的僕人來，要知道他們做生意賺了多少。

en.text: Thefirst came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

zhSimplified.text: 头一个上来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了十锭。』

zhTraditional.text: 頭一個上來，說：『主啊，你的一錠銀子已經賺了十錠。』

en.text: “Hesaid to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

zhSimplified.text: 主人说：『好！良善的仆人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有权柄管十座城。』

zhTraditional.text: 主人說：『好！良善的僕人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有權柄管十座城。』

en.text: “Thesecond came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

zhSimplified.text: 第二个来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了五锭。』

zhTraditional.text: 第二個來，說：『主啊， 你的一錠銀子已經賺了五錠。』

en.text: “Sohe said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

zhSimplified.text: 主人说：『你也可以管五座城。』

zhTraditional.text: 主人說：『你也可以管五座城。』

en.text: Anothercame, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

zhSimplified.text: 又有一个来说：『主啊，看哪，你的一锭银子在这里，我把它包在手巾里存着。

zhTraditional.text: 又有一個來說：『主啊，看哪，你的一錠銀子在這裏，我把它包在手巾裏存着。

en.text: forI feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

zhSimplified.text: 我原是怕你，因为你是严厉的人；没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收。』

zhTraditional.text: 我原是怕你，因為你是嚴厲的人；沒有放下的，還要去拿， 沒有種下的，還要去收。』

en.text: “Hesaid to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’ t lay down and reaping that which I didn’ t sow.

zhSimplified.text: 主人对他说：『你这恶仆，我要凭你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是严厉的人，没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收，

zhTraditional.text: 主人對他說：『你這惡僕，我要憑你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是嚴厲的人，沒有放下的，還要去拿，沒有種下的，還要去收，

en.text: Thenwhy didn’ t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

zhSimplified.text: 为什么不把我的银子交给银行，等我来的时候，连本带利都可以要回来呢？』

zhTraditional.text: 為甚麼不把我的銀子交給銀行，等我來的時候，連本帶利都可以要回來呢？』

en.text: Hesaid to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

zhSimplified.text: 就对旁边站着的人说：『夺过他这一锭来，给那有十锭的。』

zhTraditional.text: 就對旁邊站着的人說：『奪過他這一錠來，給那有十錠的。』

en.text: “Theysaid to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：『主啊，他已经有十锭了。』

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：『主啊，他已經有十錠了。』

en.text: ‘ForI tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’ t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

zhSimplified.text: 主人说：『我告诉你们，凡有的，还要加给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。

zhTraditional.text: 主人說：『我告訴你們，凡有的，還要加給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。

en.text: Butbring those enemies of mine who didn’ t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

zhSimplified.text: 至于我那些仇敌，不要我作他们王的，把他们拉来，在我面前杀了吧！』」 （太21·1—11；可11·1—11；约12·12—19）

zhTraditional.text: 至於我那些仇敵，不要我作他們王的，把他們拉來，在我面前殺了吧！』」 （太21‧1－11；可11‧1－11；約12‧12－19）

en.text: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说完了这话，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說完了這話，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。

en.text: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

zhSimplified.text: 将近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄榄山那里，就打发两个门徒，说：

zhTraditional.text: 將近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄欖山那裏，就打發兩個門徒，說：

en.text: saying, “Goyour way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们往对面村子里去，进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开牵来。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們往對面村子裏去，進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裏，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開牽來。

en.text: Ifanyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

zhSimplified.text: 若有人问为什么解它，你们就说：『主要用它。』」

zhTraditional.text: 若有人問為甚麼解牠，你們就說：『主要用牠。』」

en.text: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

zhSimplified.text: 打发的人去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。

zhTraditional.text: 打發的人去了，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。

en.text: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

zhSimplified.text: 他们解驴驹的时候，主人问他们说：「解驴驹做什么？」

zhTraditional.text: 他們解驢駒的時候，主人問他們說：「解驢駒做甚麼？」

en.text: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「主要用它。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「主要用牠。」

en.text: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶稣骑上。

zhTraditional.text: 他們牽到耶穌那裏，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶穌騎上。

en.text: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

zhSimplified.text: 走的时候，众人把衣服铺在路上。

zhTraditional.text: 走的時候，眾人把衣服鋪在路上。

en.text: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

zhSimplified.text: 将近耶路撒冷，正下橄榄山的时候，众门徒因所见过的一切异能，都欢乐起来，大声赞美 神，

zhTraditional.text: 將近耶路撒冷，正下橄欖山的時候，眾門徒因所見過的一切異能，都歡樂起來，大聲讚美上帝，

en.text: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

zhSimplified.text: 说： 奉主名来的王是应当称颂的！ 在天上有和平； 在至高之处有荣光。

zhTraditional.text: 說： 奉主名來的王是應當稱頌的！ 在天上有和平； 在至高之處有榮光。

en.text: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

zhSimplified.text: 众人中有几个法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，责备你的门徒吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人中有幾個法利賽人對耶穌說：「夫子，責備你的門徒吧！」

en.text: He answered them, “Itell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「我告诉你们，若是他们闭口不说，这些石头必要呼叫起来。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「我告訴你們，若是他們閉口不說，這些石頭必要呼叫起來。」

en.text: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣快到耶路撒冷，看见城，就为它哀哭，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌快到耶路撒冷，看見城，就為它哀哭，

en.text: saying, “Ifyou, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 说：「巴不得你在这日子知道关系你平安的事；无奈这事现在是隐藏的，叫你的眼看不出来。

zhTraditional.text: 說：「巴不得你在這日子知道關係你平安的事；無奈這事現在是隱藏的，叫你的眼看不出來。

en.text: Forthe days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

zhSimplified.text: 因为日子将到，你的仇敌必筑起土垒，周围环绕你，四面困住你，

zhTraditional.text: 因為日子將到，你的仇敵必築起土壘，周圍環繞你，四面困住你，

en.text: andwill dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’ t know the time of your visitation.”

zhSimplified.text: 并要扫灭你和你里头的儿女，连一块石头也不留在石头上，因你不知道眷顾你的时候。」 （太21·12—17；可11·15—19；约2·13—22）

zhTraditional.text: 並要掃滅你和你裏頭的兒女，連一塊石頭也不留在石頭上，因你不知道眷顧你的時候。」 （太21‧12－17；可11‧15－19；約2‧13－22）

en.text: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣进了殿，赶出里头做买卖的人，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌進了殿，趕出裏頭做買賣的人，

en.text: saying to them, “Itis written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ butyou have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

zhSimplified.text: 对他们说：「经上说： 我的殿必作祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」

zhTraditional.text: 對他們說：「經上說： 我的殿必作禱告的殿， 你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」

en.text: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣天天在殿里教训人。祭司长和文士与百姓的尊长都想要杀他，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌天天在殿裏教訓人。祭司長和文士與百姓的尊長都想要殺他，

en.text: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

zhSimplified.text: 但寻不出法子来，因为百姓都侧耳听他。

zhTraditional.text: 但尋不出法子來，因為百姓都側耳聽他。
